integrity.finite_checks: Independent direct-subsequence and interval-support exhaustive tests to q=5, plus q=6,7 second-half permutation scans; these supplement but do not replace the infinite proof.

limitations: Complete equality classification applies to words where each of q distinct letters occurs exactly twice, not arbitrary length-2q words with unbalanced multiplicities.
The previously published upper bound 2^(q+1)-2 is background, not a new discovery.
Independent audit and external replication have not been performed.
Some less directly relevant literature was accessible only as an indexed abstract.
title: Exactly two double-occurrence maximizers of distinct scattered palindromes
